item.title: Ask an Artist to Review Translated Captions
item.audience: the artist who wrote the captions
item.prompt_text: Your community gallery is preparing a bilingual edition of three short captions about an artist's work. One caption uses a phrase that can mean either removing something from a public place or letting it fade naturally. Write to the artist to explain why one phrase needs clarification, propose how to handle it in the translation, and ask the artist to review the translated captions before Friday.
item.target_grammar: Polite indirect questions; modal choices; referring to earlier text with this and that.
item.target_structure: Purpose → example of the ambiguity → translation options → bounded review request.

checklist.point: Identify the project and the caption ambiguity.
Offer a practical way to represent the intended meaning.
Ask for a review before Friday and say what feedback is most useful.
